newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy's Milan to publish February CPI on Feb 20.
newsitem.headline: Italy's Milan to publish February CPI on Feb 20.

text.p: The Italian city of Milan will publish its preliminary February consumer price index (CPI) inflation data on February 20 at around 1630 GMT, the city's official press office said.

In January, Milan showed a month-on-month CPI rise of 0.2 percent and a year-on-year rate of 2.8 percent, compared to a monthly 0.2 percent rise and 2.6 percent annual rate in January for the whole of Italy.
Milan's CPI weighing is a just less than 20 percent of the total national weighting. The official February CPI inflation data will be published on March 4.
